preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The root must be either None or an instance of TreeNode, representing an empty tree or the root of an existing AVL tree.
The value to be inserted must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, TreeNode) or return_value is None
postconditions.description: The function returns a TreeNode (the new root of the modified AVL tree) or None if the tree was empty before insertion.

postconditions.expression: all(node.left.height == node.right.height + 1 or node.left.height + 1 == node.right.height or node.left.height == node.right.height for node in inorder_traversal(return_value))
postconditions.description: The returned tree must satisfy the AVL balance property: for every node, the heights of the left and right subtrees differ by at most 1.

postconditions.expression: all(value in inorder_traversal(return_value) for value in [value] + (inorder_traversal(root) if root else []))
postconditions.description: The returned tree must contain all values from the original tree plus the newly inserted value, in correct BST order.

postconditions.expression: return_value is None or return_value.val == value or (return_value.left and return_value.left.val == value) or (return_value.right and return_value.right.val == value) or (return_value.left and value in inorder_traversal(return_value.left)) or (return_value.right and value in inorder_traversal(return_value.right))
postconditions.description: The inserted value must be present in the returned tree, either as the root, in the left subtree, or in the right subtree, following BST rules.

invariants.expression: all(node.left.height == node.right.height + 1 or node.left.height + 1 == node.right.height or node.left.height == node.right.height for node in inorder_traversal(root))
invariants.description: The AVL balance property must hold for all nodes in the tree before and after insertion.

invariants.expression: all(node.left.val < node.val < node.right.val if node.left and node.right else True for node in inorder_traversal(root))
invariants.description: The BST property must hold for all nodes in the tree before and after insertion.
